provenance: IBM AMLworld HI-Small - the exact held-out rows the browser scores, in the 32-feature graph space the teacher consumes. Raw transaction fields are deliberately not used: amount against time shows no separation and would imply the task is impossible, when the signal is in the graph structure.
licence: CDLA-Sharing-1.0 (SHARE-ALIKE - this derived slice carries the same terms)
attribution: Altman, Blanusa, von Niederhausern, Egressy, Anghel & Atasu, 'Realistic Synthetic Financial Transactions for Anti-Money Laundering Models', NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks. Corpus is synthetic by IBM's own statement, generated by a multi-agent simulator.
note: AUC-PR 0.2302 against a 0.0173 base rate is a 13.3x lift and still a LOW number. That is the honest picture - two features do not solve AML, and a projection that looked easy would be the misleading one. NOT the highest-scoring pair available (format_risk x src_bank_diversity reaches 0.3195) because that one has six distinct values and renders as bands against the origin: separability and readability are different criteria and this chart needs both.
